context_docs: Martian Southern Summer. The period of Mars southern hemisphere summer, defined by solar longitude between 180 and 360 degrees. Also called aphelion season. Aliases: southern summer, southern hemisphere summer, aphelion season, martian summer, southern warm season. Schema fields: solar_longitude.

Martian Northern Summer. The period of Mars northern hemisphere summer, defined by solar longitude between 0 and 180 degrees. Associated with perihelion season and elevated dust storm risk. Aliases: northern summer, northern hemisphere summer, perihelion season, dust storm season, northern warm season. Schema fields: solar_longitude.

Mars Perihelion. The point in Mars orbit closest to the Sun, occurring around solar longitude 250 degrees. Associated with warmer southern hemisphere and peak dust storm risk. Aliases: perihelion, mars perihelion, perihelion passage, closest to sun, peak dust season. Schema fields: solar_longitude.

Water Ice Clouds. Water ice clouds on Mars that form primarily during the aphelion cloud belt season (Ls 50-150 degrees) near the equator. Aliases: water ice clouds, ice clouds, aphelion cloud belt, ACB, martian clouds, equatorial clouds, cloud belt, cloud opacity. Schema fields: solar_longitude.

Mars Aphelion. The point in Mars orbit farthest from the Sun, occurring around solar longitude 70 degrees. Associated with cooler temperatures and the aphelion cloud belt. Aliases: aphelion, mars aphelion, aphelion passage, farthest from sun, aphelion cloud belt season. Schema fields: solar_longitude.

HiRISE High-Resolution Imaging. High Resolution Imaging Science Experiment on MRO, providing the highest resolution images of Mars surface at sub-meter scale (0.25-0.5 m/pixel). Aliases: hirise, high resolution imaging, sub-meter imagery, high res camera, color imaging MRO, 25cm resolution. Schema fields: mission_name, pixel_resolution_x.

CRISM Hyperspectral Imaging. Compact Reconnaissance Imaging Spectrometer for Mars on MRO. Maps surface mineralogy. Modes include FRT (full resolution targeted) and HRL (half-resolution long). Aliases: crism, hyperspectral, spectrometer MRO, mineralogy mapper, FRT, HRL, targeted spectrometer, surface composition mapping, spectral imaging. Schema fields: mission_name.

SHARAD Radargrams. Subsurface radar sounding data from the SHARAD instrument on MRO. Used to image subsurface layering, polar deposits, and ice. Data type is radargram. Aliases: sharad, subsurface radar, ice penetrating radar, ground penetrating radar mars, radar sounder, subsurface sounder, radargram, radar cross section, stratigraphic profiles from orbit. Schema fields: mission_name.

CTX Context Camera. Context Camera on MRO providing wide-field grayscale images at approximately 6 m/pixel resolution over a 30 km swath. Aliases: ctx, context camera, context imager, 6 meter resolution, wide angle camera MRO, 30km swath, context imagery. Schema fields: mission_name, pixel_resolution_x.

MRO Aerobraking Phase. The aerobraking phase of the Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter mission in 2006, during which limited science data was collected due to non-science orbit geometry. Aliases: aerobraking, aerobraking phase, MRO aerobraking, 2006 aerobraking, orbital insertion phase, pre-science phase MRO. Schema fields: mission_phase_name, start_date_time, stop_date_time.
